# Wrecked Metal v0.1.4 — Weather

Rain, thunderstorms and snow on the race tracks.

> **You need your own ROM.** This release contains no ROM and no game assets, exactly like the earlier betas.

## New

- **Random weather.** The first race tracks roll clear skies, rain or a thunderstorm each race. Some tracks have fixed weather: always rain on the dirt canyon, always snow on the glacier and on the night city, and the desert stays dry. Arenas have no weather.
- **Thunderstorms** with lightning flashes and thunder (the sound is generated in code, nothing from the game).
- **New snow:** thicker, softer flakes in three layers of depth that drift and sway, with the near ones sweeping past the camera.
- Turn random weather off, or change the odds per track, in `Data/wm_tuning.ini` (`[weather]`). **Play Fidelity** keeps the original weather.

## Install

Download the APK below and install it over the previous version: your settings, save and ROM are kept.

**Requirements:** Android 10+, Vulkan, and a device that can run 32-bit apps (this build is `armeabi-v7a`).

## Support

Wrecked Metal is free and will stay free. If you'd like to support the work, tips are welcome on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/costelinha_games). Entirely voluntary, and nothing is locked behind them.
